title: T1055.001 — Process Injection - Dynamic-link Library Injection
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Process Injection - Dynamic-link Library Injection with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated diagram of a DLL injection attack: a dropper writes a DLL to disk, injects it into explorer.exe, and the SOC correlates Sysmon events and isolates the host.

steps.title: Foothold
steps.caption: A user opens a malicious installer from an email. The installer drops a small dropper program that runs in the user's session.
steps.defender: Sysmon (Microsoft's free system monitor that records detailed Windows event logs) event 1 records a suspicious new process tree starting from a temp folder.
